name: 🔎 Literature Search Ingest
description: Guided literature discovery, user-approved single-paper research delegation, metadata and public-PDF curation, and serial Zotero ingest through zotero-bridge.

prompts.common: 执行 literature-search-ingest。输入：query={{ parameter.query }}，searchMode={{ parameter.searchMode }}，targetCollection={{ parameter.targetCollection }}。遵循 SKILL.md 及 Skill 包中的其他指令，当所有任务执行完成时，原样返回 gate 的 final_output。
